expectation: Membrane ring or granular staining on scattered neutrophils, a rare population, mostly in vessels and lamina propria of this gut tissue. CD66b should sit on a subset of CD11b+ cells, not on epithelium or the tissue edge.
observed: A: round bright blobs on the slide and a yellow glow along the right tissue edge, with stripe-like streaks. B/C: diffuse haze that follows the tissue, with one blob. D: a lumpy, edge-sited smear around the brightest cells. E: a few faint specks, and CD11b is hazy with large blobs.
why: The signal is edge glow, haze and round debris. No distinct subset of ring-stained cells sits where neutrophils should, and E shows no clear overlap with CD11b cells.
